migration.objective: Add an internal Postgres store for atomic multi-instance sliding-window rate limiting.
migration.target_environment: Live Supabase PostgreSQL 17.6 after disposable PostgreSQL 16.14 rehearsal

include: Create public.rate_limit_hits with caller-window and cleanup indexes
Enable RLS and revoke Data API roles
Deploy the B-3 FastAPI reader/writer only after schema expansion
exclude: Deploying or reconfiguring the FastAPI service
Running live application or Android smoke tests
Changing Android or the HTTP error/header contract
maintenance_or_downtime_constraints: No planned downtime; the table is additive and initially empty

source.schema_revision: Live Supabase has migrations 004 through 007 observed applied; migrations 006 and 007 applied and verified on 2026-08-14
source.database_engine_and_version: Live Supabase PostgreSQL 17.6; disposable PostgreSQL 16.14 rehearsal
data_profile_evidence: Migrations 004 and 005 were observed present before this execution
Migrations 006 and 007 were applied from pinned hashes and verified in fresh read-only transactions
A protected off-site logical export was hash-verified before DDL
FastAPI deployment and live runtime behavior remain unverified

invariants: At most the configured allowance is accepted per hashed caller and bucket in any 60-second sliding window
No bearer token, debug user id, or IP address is stored in plaintext
No Data API client role can access rate_limit_hits

caches_events_and_replicas: No cache or event consumer; normal database replication applies
mixed_version_compatibility: Old FastAPI revisions ignore the additive table
B-3 FastAPI refuses startup until migration 007 exists
Apply schema first, then deploy code; rollback code before optional table removal
privacy_retention_security: caller_key is a truncated SHA-256 digest with a source-type prefix
Rows are ephemeral and expired rows are removed in bounded batches
RLS is enabled with no client policy and all Data API roles are revoked

operations.name: Preflight live schema and recovery evidence
operations.action_or_pseudocode: Observed migrations 004 and 005 present, confirmed 006 and 007 absent, verified PostgreSQL 17.6 and the protected off-site logical export, then pinned the remaining SQL hashes.
preconditions: Protected logical export hash-verified outside Git
operations.idempotency_and_restart: All checks are read-only and may be restarted
operations.verification: Passed: 004/005 contracts matched; 006/007 absent; transaction_read_only on; no invalid public index
monitoring: Recorded exact schema revision, PostgreSQL 17.6, candidate hashes, and backup hashes
operations.pause_or_abort: Stop on schema drift, failed backup evidence, or missing authority

operations.name: Expand schema with retention index and rate-limit storage
operations.action_or_pseudocode: Applied pinned migration 006 outside a transaction, verified its concurrent index, then applied pinned migration 007 in its short DDL transaction and independently verified it.
preconditions: Bruce explicitly overrode the missing S0ra1n0 review hold point without claiming that review occurred
operations.transaction_and_locking: MIG-006 used CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside a transaction; MIG-007 used one short DDL transaction on a new empty table
operations.compatibility: Old application revisions ignore the new table
operations.idempotency_and_restart: CREATE IF NOT EXISTS and guarded indexes make a clean matching target re-runnable; stop on divergent pre-existing objects
operations.verification: Passed: all MIG-006/007 indexes valid/ready/live, exact MIG-007 columns and constraints, RLS on, zero policies, and all 30 effective Data API privilege checks false
operations.pause_or_abort: Abort on any SQL error or unexpected existing object definition
operations.rollback_or_forward_recovery: MIG-006 would require a separately approved concurrent index drop; MIG-007 rolled back on transaction failure, and after commit the unused additive table may safely remain

operations.name: Switch FastAPI to the shared store
operations.action_or_pseudocode: Deploy the pinned B-3 FastAPI revision and perform health plus rate-limit smoke checks.
preconditions: B-3 commit and configuration are pinned
operations.transaction_and_locking: Per request, transaction-level advisory lock scoped to hashed caller and bucket
operations.compatibility: Requires migration 007; startup fails with a named message when absent
operations.idempotency_and_restart: Application deployment is repeatable; limiter rows are ephemeral and need no backfill
operations.verification: Two instances jointly accept exactly the configured allowance and return canonical 429 headers thereafter
operations.pause_or_abort: Rollback application on startup failure, elevated 5xx, database pool exhaustion, or incorrect allowance
operations.rollback_or_forward_recovery: Redeploy the pre-B-3 application; leave the additive table in place

operations.name: Observe shared limiter behavior
operations.action_or_pseudocode: Observe database latency, lock waits, pool saturation, 429 rate, and expired-row count through the agreed window.
operations.idempotency_and_restart: Observation queries may be repeated without mutation
operations.verification: No sustained lock waits or unbounded expired rows
operations.pause_or_abort: Rollback application if rate-limit database work materially degrades API availability
operations.rollback_or_forward_recovery: Application rollback; evaluate Redis only with measured evidence
